22/G.goal: Explain the main categories of AR software and compare their representative tools, capabilities, advantages, and limitations.
22/G.achieves: It gives the learner foundational AR software knowledge for making informed tool choices when designing or implementing an XR system.

22/O1.goal: Classify AR software tools as rapid prototyping tools, plugins to existing tools, or standalone authoring tools, and explain their representative examples, features, advantages, and limitations.
22/O1.achieves: It lets the learner evaluate which AR software approach is suitable for prototyping or building an AR application.
